quotes.text: The duty provided in the applicable subheading + 12.5%
articles the product of China, as provided for in U.S. note 52 to this subchapter

all products that are subject to the additional ad valorem rates of duty imposed by headings 9903.05.20–9903.05.84 shall also be subject to any additional duty provided for in this subchapter or in subchapter IV of chapter 99

all products that are subject to the additional ad valorem rates of duty imposed by these headings shall also be subject to the general rates of duty imposed under subheadings in chapters 1 to 97 of the tariff schedule
For the purposes of heading 9903.88.01, products of China, as provided for in this note, shall be subject to an additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty.
Heading 9903.88.01 applies to all products of China that are classified in the following 8-digit subheadings
The duty provided in the applicable subheading plus 25%

Notwithstanding U.S. note 1 to this subchapter, all products of China that are subject to the additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty imposed by heading 9903.88.01 shall also be subject to the general rates of duty imposed on products of China classified in the subheadings enumerated in U.S. note 20(b) to subchapter III
For the purposes of heading 9903.88.02, products of China, as provided for in this note, shall be subject to an additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty.
Heading 9903.88.02 applies to all products of China that are classified in the following 8-digit subheadings
The duty provided in the applicable subheading + 25%

Notwithstanding U.S. note 1 to this subchapter, all products of China that are subject to the additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty imposed by heading 9903.88.02 shall also be subject to the general rates of duty imposed on products of China classified in the subheadings enumerated in U.S. note 20(d) to subchapter III
For the purposes of heading 9903.88.03, products of China, as provided for in this note, shall be subject to an additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty.
Heading 9903.88.03 applies to all products of China that are classified in the following 8-digit subheadings
The duty provided in the applicable subheading + 25%

Notwithstanding U.S. note 1 to this subchapter, all products of China that are subject to the additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty imposed by heading 9903.88.03 shall also be subject to the general rates of duty imposed on products of China classified in the subheadings enumerated in U.S. note 20(f) to subchapter III
For the purposes of heading 9903.88.15, products of China, as provided for in this note, shall be subject to an additional 7.5 percent ad valorem rate of duty.
Heading 9903.88.15 applies to:
all products of China that are classified in the following 8-digit subheadings
The duty provided in the applicable subheading + 7.5%

Notwithstanding U.S. note 1 to this subchapter, all products of China that are subject to the additional 7.5 percent ad valorem rate of duty imposed by heading 9903.88.15 shall also be subject to the general rates of duty imposed on products of China classified in the subheadings enumerated in U.S. note 20(s)(i)
as provided for in the subheadings enumerated in U.S. note 20(u) [Compiler's note: provision suspended.]
Subdivisions (t) and (u) of this note and heading 9903.88.16 suspended.
As provided in heading 9903.05.86, the duties imposed by headings 9903.05.20–9903.05.84 shall not apply to articles that are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS
Articles provided for in subdivision (b) of U.S. note 52 to this subchapter
As provided in heading 9903.05.87, the duties imposed by headings 9903.05.20–9903.05.84 shall not apply to the following particular articles
Articles provided for in subdivision (c) of U.S. note 52 to this subchapter

As provided in heading 9903.05.88, the additional duties imposed by headings 9903.05.20–9903.05.84 shall not apply to articles that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components
as provided for in subdivision (d) of U.S. note 52 to this subchapter
As provided in heading 9903.05.89, the additional duties imposed by headings 9903.05.20–9903.05.84 shall not apply to articles that are for use in pharmaceutical applications
Articles for use in pharmaceutical applications, as provided for in subdivision (e) of U.S. note 52 to this subchapter
As provided in heading 9903.05.90, the additional duties imposed by headings 9903.05.20–9903.05.84 shall not apply to:
as provided in subdivision (f) of U.S. note 52 to this subchapter
Articles that are donations by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States

Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds
